blocks.text: This test build uses separate wallet storage, starts on testnet on first launch, and does not check for or install updates. Install subsequent test builds manually.
Touch ID for the macOS testnet wallet

items: In the Touch ID edition, set up fingerprint unlock before the wallet opens. After entering your password or completing wallet setup, choose Enable Touch ID and touch the sensor, or choose Later.
macOS handles fingerprint retries. If authentication fails, enter your wallet password. You can also choose Use password at any time.
During a Touch ID lockout, Settings explains how to restore access with your Mac account password. If the wallet's fingerprint enrollment is no longer valid, choose Set up Touch ID again in Settings.
Turning off fingerprint unlock requires a fresh Touch ID check, or your wallet password if Touch ID is unavailable.
